text: 在上交所国际投资者大会上，安联投资亚太区股票产品专家主管William Russell表示，从全球投资者角度来看，中国资产在全球资产配置中已扮演更加战略性角色，目前已不是何时配置的问题，而是如何战略性配置。“在过去几周的波动中，国际投资者越来越考虑在中国进行投资，来互补或分散现有的投资组合。”他说。 (证券时报)
text_en: At the SSE Global Investor Conference, William Russell, Head of Asia-Pacific Equity Product Specialists at Allianz Global Investors, said that from a global investor's perspective, Chinese assets have come to play a more strategic role in global asset allocation, and the question is no longer when to allocate but how to allocate strategically. "Amid the volatility of recent weeks, international investors are increasingly considering investing in China to complement or diversify their existing portfolios," he said. (Securities Times)
